info.name: Delta Backend Catalog And Product GCS Flow
info.description: Postman collection for the name-derived slug catalog API. Admin create/update requests send company_name, optional category_name, and document_name; writable slug fields and display_name are unsupported. PDFs stay private behind signed URLs, while thumbnails use public company/optional-category paths in darshanent-thumbnail-dir. document_id remains stable across document updates. POST /api/catalog/access is inquiry-only; Google access and challenge-specific OTP verification grant the catalog_access cookie. Do not put GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or service account JSON content in Postman. Product API folders cover Firestore companies/categories, bounded product queries, filtering, search, sorting, cursor pagination, product details, signed GCS assets, and validation errors.

item.name: Get Products By Company Category And Stock

exec: pm.test('all products match combined filters', function () {
pm.test('all products are out of stock', function () { json.data.forEach(function (product) { pm.expect(product.inStock).to.eql(false); }); });
pm.test('search uses listing contract', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.pagination).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('names are descending', function () { for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i += 1) pm.expect(values[i - 1].localeCompare(values[i])).to.be.at.least(0); });
pm.test('prices are ascending', function () { for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i += 1) pm.expect(values[i - 1]).to.be.at.most(values[i]); });
pm.test('prices are descending', function () { for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i += 1) pm.expect(values[i - 1]).to.be.at.least(values[i]); });
pm.test('next page uses listing contract', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.pagination.hasMore).to.be.a('boolean'); });
